exposure: fewer than three antenatal care (ANC) visits
undergoing five or more pelvic examinations during labor
cohort: The study cohort consisted of mothers who gave birth at two public hospitals in Jigjiga, Eastern Ethiopia, with 76 cases of puerperal sepsis and 151 controls.
finding: Advanced maternal age (≥ 35 years), fewer than three antenatal care visits, undergoing five or more pelvic examinations during labor, and the presence of maternal anemia were significant determinants independently associated with an increased risk of puerperal sepsis.
